lanes.statement: The three behaviour assertions were each produced by pressing the region own control: the seeded expert site, the seeded workspace and the seeded balance were all read from the store and rendered exactly, and the workspace control opened the seeded id.

UX-12 makes the lens fix-first at a mean of 3.5455 with two gating criteria failed: the task rule, because a declared alternate path renders nowhere, and the dead-end rule, because the empty addresses state and the refused runtime state each offer no action at all.

The one UI assertion failed: the runtime region shows a refused pod read where the frozen case expects one running and one degraded pod with the degraded one marked for attention. The render is truthful; the expectation names content this composition never reads.

entries.measured: the terminal frame was reached 10.45s into a 30s budget and every step came from a visible label, but one declared alternate path, block-partially-refused, renders nowhere in this composition
one committed step from the declared entry to the terminal frame against a budget of two, and the offered next step one press away on a console
a deliberately wrong sign-in value was refused, both entered values survived, the correction was made at its own field and the terminal frame returned 308ms later
the first visible change after a press was under 1ms, and each onward navigation settled in about 5.1s behind the destination region own loading copy
the destination is the landing surface at zero levels and its three place signals agree: address /en/overview, heading Overview, active navigation item Overview
the addresses empty state carries zero controls and only explains, and the refused runtime region carries zero controls with no retry and no alternative
back returned the surface with its values, reload kept the same surface and the same balance, and the address opened in a profile that had never signed in landed on the sign-in surface
both fields carry visible labels and the autofill hints their type expects, tab order equalled reading order, and Enter from the password field reached the terminal frame
at 390x844 the header primary action sits at y=209 and the offered next step at y=1426 of an 844-tall frame, both static, neither in the lower half nor in a sticky bar
the top-up verb is the same on the overview and on the wallet surface, and both sit at the end of the account region they belong to
headings are nouns and controls are verbs with no stub copy in any reached state, but the signals band dates an amount as due 09/06 with no year and no stated order
